# 1798. Maximum Number of Consecutive Values You Can Make

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def getMaximumConsecutive(self, coins):
        """
        :type coins: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        coins.sort()
        ans = 1
        for t in coins:
            if t > ans:
                break
            ans += t
        return ans
```
